subject: CHECKPOINT: hard service cadence conflicts with DMSH/3 sparse-write budget
body: findingDelta=NEW; SOURCE-level process contradiction: DMSH3_PROTOCOL_V1/WRITE_BUDGET_V1 require sparse writes, routine progress local, and standalone heartbeat only after quiet interval, while ACTIVE_AGENT_SERVICE_INTERVAL_V1 supersedes timing and mandates both immutable node + immutable message every 30s target/60s max even for NO_DELTA. This doubles durable objects per interval and forces provenance-plane churn for liveness-only state. Measurement in progress.
